title: Ali ne Pukara Fatema Zahra
body:
Ali Ali Ali Ne Pukara Fatema Zehra
Hil gaye arsh o zameen, zulm ye kaisa huwa
Hoti Thi'n Baba Ke Gham Mein Ashkbar
Lagta Tha Logo'n Ko Roona Na Gawar
Zalimo Ne Haye Roone Bhi Nhi Tumko Diya
Haq Talab Karke Jab Aayi'n Lawt Kar
Gir Gayi'n Behosh Ho kar Khaq Par
Zalimon Ne Aapko Darbar Mein Jhutla Diya
Hashr Tak Is Zakm Ka Marham Nhi
Rooz e Ashura Se Kam Ye Gham Nhi
Karbala Se Pehle Hai Ye Bhi Jaise Karbala
Baazu e Aqdas Mein Darwaze Ki Keel
Legya Mohsin Ki Jaa'n Pehlu Ka Neel
Ha Daro Diwar Ke Darmiyan Thi Ye Jafa
Gusal Jab Mola Ne Zehra Ko Diya
Sher e Haq Ko Ye Bada Sadma Hua
Pasliyaa'n Tooti Hui Thi Ali Ki Ye Sada
Zainab o Kulsoom Ki Kya Zindagi
Maa Bina Mar Jayengi Ab Jitey Ji
Qabar Zehra Ki Hili Jab Ali Ne Ye Kaha
Gham Mein Zehra Ke NASEEM e Gham Zada
Jiss Ghadi IMRAN Ne Noha Padha
Chodd Kar Firdous Ko Aagye Mushkil Kusha
